text:
eva: Quick postmortem note — yesterday a manual SIEM export ran to a temp bucket and contained ~14 months of auth logs. We quarantined the bucket but want a fast set of guardrails.

priya: Can you confirm svc-account and size?

eva: svc-siem-runner, ~95GB, job id SIE-2026-03-22-77. Linked logs and run artifact in infra logs.

tom: Root cause recap: export tool allowed manual run without approval. svc-account had broad kms:Decrypt + s3:PutObject scoped to temp buckets.

ben: Legal: need chain-of-custody and to know if PII was exposed. If >500 unique customers we may need notification.

priya: Immediate mitigations: 1) revoke svc-siem-runner creds; 2) add bucket quarantines; 3) rotate CMK used for unwrap. Done?

eva: Done for 1 & 2; CMK rotation in flight.

priya: Proposed medium-term changes: - export-api that mints ephemeral roles after 2 approvers - default redaction (sample/tokenize) - kms-proxy must log unwraps to immutable audit-store

tom: IAM guardrail idea: deny s3:PutObject on export buckets except when aws:SourceIdentity includes export_request_id and role is ephemeral. Default TTL 2h.

ben: Legal requests that any full-history export include a forensics_preserve flag which writes a WORM-scoped hash+metadata to audit-store.

audit-bot: export_event created id=SIE-2026-03-22-77 by eva status=pending_review

priya: Detection rule: if export >50GB OR touches >90 days of history OR >500k rows -> auto-pause and open INFSEC ticket. Also block exports to non-whitelisted buckets.

eva: I'll draft an RFC and runbook. Owners: infra/tom, security/priya & eva, legal/ben. Goal: implement basic guardrails in 2 wks.

priya: One more: default ad-hoc export sampling = 1% unless justification provided. Less exposure and cheaper.

eva: Thanks all — filing INFSEC ticket and will attach logs/links. :lock:
